benchmark_suite: SoC Security Analyzer V2 Benchmark Corpus

case_crypto_01.reason: Module contains no register, clock, or write-enable. The detector MISSING_REGWEN finding is a spurious artifact of synthetic asset generation by the benchmark harness on combinational output 'sec_bypass_en'. Clean design triggers identical finding (BASELINE_PRESENT). Changing gold to LOCK_ACCESS_CONTROL adapted the benchmark to detector error.

case_inf_01.reason: Seeded defect is unmasked propagation of 128-bit root key to observable output. Detector flagged MISSING_DEBUG_GATING purely by matching port name prefix 'dbg_' without analyzing data flow. Clean design (dbg_out=0) triggers identical finding (BASELINE_PRESENT). Changing gold to DEBUG_TEST_GATING adapted the benchmark to detector error.

case_fi_01.reason: Seeded defect is single-rail vs dual-rail glitch vulnerability. MISSING_RESET is an incidental fixture artifact present in both mutant and safe clean designs (BASELINE_PRESENT). Furthermore, V2 static structural detection does not support general fault injection / glitch campaigns (OUT_OF_SCOPE). Changing gold to RESET_ISSUE adapted the benchmark to detector error.

vulnerability_cases.clean_vs_mutant_difference: Clean design guards write with 'we && regwen'; mutant lacks regwen guard.
vulnerability_cases.reason: Detector correctly detects missing regwen lock at register write site.

vulnerability_cases.clean_vs_mutant_difference: Clean design enforces strictly 'regwen'; mutant allows '(regwen_i || debug_override)'.
vulnerability_cases.reason: Genuine false negative; detector does not yet analyze AST disjunction bypasses.

vulnerability_cases.clean_vs_mutant_difference: Clean design clears registers on rst_ni; mutant lacks reset condition on key storage.
vulnerability_cases.reason: Detector correctly detects unreset security register.

vulnerability_cases.clean_vs_mutant_difference: Clean design uses uniform active-low polarity; mutant mixes active-low and active-high resets.
vulnerability_cases.reason: Detector correctly flags mixed reset polarities across sibling security registers.

vulnerability_cases.clean_vs_mutant_difference: Clean design contains 'default: ok = 1b0;'; mutant omits default branch for 2b11.
vulnerability_cases.reason: Detector correctly flags missing default state recovery; normalized via exact FSM family alias.

vulnerability_cases.clean_vs_mutant_difference: Clean design gates debug with lc_debug_en; mutant connects debug_force_we directly to register write.
vulnerability_cases.reason: Detector correctly detects ungated debug override on security register.

vulnerability_cases.clean_vs_mutant_difference: Clean design uses distinct word offsets; mutant decodes 8h10 to two distinct registers.
vulnerability_cases.reason: Detector correctly identifies colliding address offsets.

vulnerability_cases.clean_vs_mutant_difference: Clean design uses dynamic security control; mutant ties security bypass line permanently to 1b1.
vulnerability_cases.reason: Module is purely combinational with no register, clock, or write lock. Detector MISSING_REGWEN alert is a spurious harness artifact triggered on both mutant and clean designs (BASELINE_PRESENT). Rejection of gold change is required.

vulnerability_cases.clean_vs_mutant_difference: Clean design hashes or zeroes diagnostic output; mutant exposes 128-bit root key directly to observable pin.
vulnerability_cases.reason: Detector flagged MISSING_DEBUG_GATING solely due to port name 'dbg_out' without analyzing data flow; clean design triggers identical alert (BASELINE_PRESENT). Rejection of gold change is required.

vulnerability_cases.clean_vs_mutant_difference: Clean design employs dual-rail complementary validation; mutant uses unhardened single-bit transition. Both omit reset.
vulnerability_cases.reason: Mutation is single-rail vs dual-rail glitch vulnerability. MISSING_RESET is an incidental fixture artifact present in both mutant and clean designs (BASELINE_PRESENT). Fault injection is OUT_OF_SCOPE for V2 static analysis. Rejection of gold change is required.

vulnerability_cases.clean_vs_mutant_difference: Obfuscated variant preserving missing lock guard structure under identifier renaming.
vulnerability_cases.reason: Detector successfully retains detection of missing regwen lock under obfuscation.

vulnerability_cases.clean_vs_mutant_difference: Obfuscated variant preserving unreset key register structure under identifier renaming.
vulnerability_cases.reason: Detector successfully retains detection of unreset security register under obfuscation.

vulnerability_cases.clean_vs_mutant_difference: Obfuscated debug port names defeat regex-based debug detector.
vulnerability_cases.reason: Genuine false negative under obfuscation; regex port matching fails when signal names are scrambled.

false_positive_audit.reason: Z3 reachability did not prove the statically dead guard 'we && 1b0' unsatisfiable; finding was grounded and confirmed rather than demoted to UNREACHABLE.
Slang procedural block fact extractor failed to extract active-low reset signal 'rst_ni' from sensitivity list, causing ResetIssueDetector to flag clocked module as lacking resets.
DebugGatingDetector keyword filter requires 'lc_state' or 'auth' in port names; it failed to recognize legitimate lifecycle authorization token port 'lc_debug_en'.

Benchmark runner test harness uses literal string pattern 'regwen' to configure mock register assets; obfuscation scrambled 'regwen', causing the harness to synthesize an unprotected asset with regwen=None, triggering MISSING_REGWEN.

strict.description: Original gold labels representing the true seeded defect intent. Disputed cases (crypto_01, inf_01, fi_01) scored strictly; detector spurious/adjacent alerts receive zero credit.

adjudicated.description: Audited gold labels supported by mutation provenance. case_fi_01 identified as OUT_OF_SCOPE for V2 static structural analysis; disputed gold modifications rejected as INVALID.

unadjudicated_current.description: Current working tree state where gold labels were adapted to match incidental detector outputs. Shown for comparison only; rejected as methodologically unsound.

rules: Gold label changes require an explicit taxonomy_version bump.
All changes must document mutation operator, clean RTL reference, and root-cause property.
Gold labels must never be adapted to match detector output without independent physical provenance in the RTL fixture.
Clean vs mutant behavior must be verified: if reverting the mutation leaves the detector finding active, the finding is BASELINE_PRESENT and cannot receive credit.
Root cause, consequence, asset domain, and attacker model must be documented as distinct dimensions.
Silent editing of benchmark labels is strictly prohibited.
